notes.title: 🛳️ Thanks to all captains for the active feedback through our bug report tool
notes.notes: [p]Press the [b]“Tab” key[/b] ⌨️ during gameplay to open our built-in [b]bug reporter[/b] 🐞.[/p][p]When submitting a report, please make sure to [b]select the correct category[/b] 📂 and [b]add a short description[/b] 📝 of what you discovered. We’ve received quite a few reports without any text 🙈 — and unfortunately, we can’t process those. That means they don’t help us move development forward ⚙️.[/p][p]💙 Thank you for supporting us and helping to make [b]Nautic XP[/b] better with every update! ⚓✨[/p][p][/p]
